about_the_game:
Aurora Polaris is a vertical shoot 'em up with a cinematic narrative and memorable characters, set in a post-pandemic world ruled by an oppressive force known as NOX. With modern arcade gameplay, choose from four unique pilots, each with special abilities, distinct flying styles, and inspiring backstories. Battle biomechanical bosses, unlock challenging achievements, and uncover a magical secret that could reignite humanity’s hope.

🕹️ What to expect:

✅ Full campaign with 8 handcrafted stages, each featuring unique environments, enemies, and epic bosses
✅ 4 playable pilots, each with a distinct ship and special abilities: Caio, Charlotte, Hana, and Logan
✅ Local co-op for 2 players – fight alongside a friend!
✅ Progression system with upgrades shared across all characters
✅ Epic achievements and hidden easter eggs, including Dr. Artikos’ Naughty & Nice List
✅ Semi-realistic, ultra-vivid digital art style blending anime and sci-fi elements
✅ Engaging story with emotional twists, culminating in a magical and unexpected ending
✅ Full controller support and multilingual localization (Portuguese, English, and Spanish)

✨ Gameplay Highlights

Control unique ships equipped with area missiles, mirror drones, reflective shields, and tactical bombings.

Survive iconic stages such as:

  • Ice Escape – Flee from NOX forces attacking the North Pole base

  • Hacked Neo-Tokyo – Face reality-warping tech and corrupted AI

  • Eclipse Station – Confront an AI attempting to erase humanity’s emotional memory

📖 A tale of redemption, unity, and magic

At the center of it all is Dr. Artikos, an enigmatic engineer hiding an ancient secret. He brings together four unlikely pilots for one final mission: to rekindle hope. As the story unfolds, you’ll learn that magic never vanished… it was just waiting beneath the ice.

name: Aurora Polaris

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th Gen) or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GT 710 / Intel HD 4000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Recommended to use a controller for the best experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen) or Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Full support for Xbox and Steam Deck controllers.

short_description: A vertical shooter with post-apocalyptic storytelling and semi-realistic visuals, where four unlikely pilots fight against a technobiological organization to rekindle hope for humanity.
supported_languages:
English, Portuguese - Brazil*, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
